newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tallow price premium over palm stearin narrows.
newsitem.headline: Tallow price premium over palm stearin narrows.

text.p: Easier U.S. tallow prices and firmer palm oil prices are beginning to help narrow the tallow premium over palm stearin in Europe, the Oil World newsletter said.
Both can be used in products such as candles and soap.
Bleachable tallow cif Rotterdam was at $540 a tonne at the end of February, down from an average of $554 for the month as a whole.
Malaysian palm stearin RBD, cif Rotterdam was at $510 compared with a February average of $509, Oil World price lists showed.
Tallow was still up $100 from a year earlier.
The price strength over the last 12 months resulted from a combination of reduced beef production, which curtailed tallow output as a by-product, and initially lower tallow stocks.
Oil World said some consumer switching to palm stearin had taken place.

World exports of tallow and greases in 1996 dropped to 2.14 million tonnes from 2.57 million in 1995 as higher exports from New Zealand, Australia, Canada and some Asian countries failed to offset lower U.S. shipments.
